summary: James Pruitt, 70, left the Glacier Gorge parking lot for a day hike on Feb 28 and remained missing; a March 3-9 broad-scale search of ~15 square miles in chest-deep snow used numerous SAR teams, dogs and fixed-wing reconnaissance; search suspended
location: Glacier Gorge / Bear Lake area, RMNP
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park SAR, multiple SAR teams
notes: 'assist' follows index convention for unresolved missing-person searches; subject still missing when suspended March 9; county not stated (Larimer side of RMNP)
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: state (Colorado center)
